system.description:
Something looked at your bloodline from very far away and left a mark. You try not to think about what. It runs in families who meddled with occult magic.

  • Bloodline Cantrips: Phantasmal Jab and Detect Illusion.
  • Bloodline Ability (1st): See perfectly in magical and mundane darkness (as the Queen of Air and Darkness Warlock's Dark Gift).
  • Once per day, look at a creature within 60ft to read its surface thoughts (Will save to resist).
  • You have Advantage on saves against psychic damage, fear and madness, and you always sense the emotional state of a creature you can see.
  • Bloodline Awakening (10th): Once per day, one creature within 30ft makes a Fortitude save.
  • On a failure it takes 4d10 psychic damage, attacks against it have Advantage until the encounter ends, and it cannot regain HP for 1 hour; on a success it takes half damage and nothing more.
  • Or touch one unattended nonmagical object, up to a 10ft cube, and destroy it.
